description: Sends an existing Gmail draft immediately to the recipients already in its To, Cc, and Bcc headers. The draft's recipients and content cannot be changed by this action; confirm them before sending.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.
user_id.human_parameter_description: The email address of the user sending the draft. Use 'me' to send from your own account.

draft_id.title: Draft Id
draft_id.description: The ID of the draft to send. Draft IDs are typically alphanumeric strings (e.g., 'r99885592323229922'). Important: Do not confuse draft_id with message_id - they are different identifiers. Use GMAIL_LIST_DRAFTS to retrieve valid draft IDs, or GMAIL_CREATE_EMAIL_DRAFT to create a new draft and get its ID. IMPORTANT: The draft MUST already have recipients (To, Cc, or Bcc) set - this action cannot add or override recipients. If the draft has no recipients, first create a new draft with recipients using GMAIL_CREATE_EMAIL_DRAFT, or use GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL to send a new email directly.
draft_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the draft you want to send. Must be a valid draft ID from an existing draft in the user's account.

GmailMessageResponse.title: GmailMessageResponse

id.title: Id
id.description: The immutable ID of the sent message.

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: The entire email message in RFC 2822 format, base64url-encoded.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: The parsed email structure, including headers and body parts.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: A short extract of the message text.

labelIds.title: Label Ids
labelIds.description: List of IDs of labels applied to this message.

threadId.title: Thread Id
threadId.description: The ID of the thread the message belongs to.

historyId.title: History Id
historyId.description: The ID of the last history record that modified this message.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: Web UI link for this resource - set by each action's execute().

internalDate.title: Internal Date
internalDate.description: The internal timestamp of the message in milliseconds since epoch.

sizeEstimate.title: Size Estimate
sizeEstimate.description: Estimated size of the message in bytes.

GmailMessageResponse.description:
Standard Gmail message response returned by Gmail API for sent messages.
Used by actions like send_email and send_draft.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
